`list-real.txt` is real output of `flatpak list --app --columns=application,name,size,installation`
(LC_ALL=C), captured on Arch Linux.
`list-handwritten.txt`, `list-handwritten-de.txt` and `list-broken.txt` are HAND-WRITTEN from the documented
format (tab-separated, SI sizes with a no-break space, comma decimals in German locales).
